run_generate_synthetic_qa: run the script to generate synthetic QA training data from input paragraphs using cloze translation
run_identity_translation: run the script with identity translation method to generate cloze questions without external models
run_noisy_cloze_translation: run the script with noisy cloze translation for fast synthetic QA data generation
run_unmt_translation: run the script with unsupervised nmt translation method for high-quality synthetic QA data
run_named_entity_clozes: run the script with named entity clozes and wh-heuristic for improved downstream QA performance
